## 📖 Documentation Issue Type
- [ ] **Missing Documentation** - Information that should exist but doesn't
- [ ] **Incorrect Information** - Documentation that contains errors
- [ ] **Unclear Instructions** - Confusing or ambiguous content
- [ ] **Outdated Content** - Information that needs updating
- [ ] **Broken Links** - Links that don't work or go to wrong pages
- [ ] **Formatting Issues** - Display, styling, or layout problems
- [ ] **Accessibility** - Content not accessible to all users
- [ ] **Translation** - Language or localization issues

## ✅ Checklist
Before submitting, please ensure:
- [ ] I have identified the specific location of the issue
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem
- [ ] I have provided a suggested solution
- [ ] I have considered the impact on different user types
- [ ] I have checked for related documentation issues
- [ ] I have considered accessibility implications
- [ ] I understand this is an open source project
